svg.title: Red White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Red outer cap and central lower notch hand-traced. Distinct from Fisher FC.566; white painted background remains opaque. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/66.3/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
